title: emage.code platform manifest
description: Shape of implementation/platforms/<platform>.json, the per-platform input of implementation/scripts/sync.mjs. Written from the keys the generator reads (T672, TD-T671-P8); every manifest declares it as its $schema, and tests/functional/test_manifest_schema.py validates all of them. Unknown keys are refused so that a typo cannot be ignored silently. The leading underscore keeps the file out of the platform list (sync.mjs and generate-registry.py skip _*.json).

platform.description: Platform name: the --platform value of install.sh and the platform field of .generated-manifest.json.

outputDir.description: Output tree, relative to the implementation root; never absolute and never starting with '..'.

rootRelative.description: dir is relative to the implementation root, not to outputDir (Cline's .clinerules); the generator refuses a target outside the root.

mcpAgentDenies.description: Opencode only; needs mcpToolNames underscore and tools permission (sync.mjs refuses anything else).

permissionKeys.description: Opencode only (T839, SEC-T837-03): the non-MCP tool names written to the agent permission map; every other non-MCP name is left out. Never read.

permissionDenyUnlessGranted.description: Opencode only (T841, SEC-T840-01): generic tool name -> Opencode permission keys written as deny for every agent that does not hold the generic name. Deny-only.

permissionTaskAllowFromAgents.description: Opencode only (T855, SEC-T844-01): the generic tool name whose holders get a map-valued task rule, "*": deny then one allow per agent of the source agents list, by source name. Never a whole-value allow.

permissionReadDenyUnlessGranted.description: Opencode only (T855, SEC-T842-02): generic tool name -> read path patterns written as deny for every agent that does not hold the generic name. Deny-only.

extraFields.description: Opencode: fixed top-level fields of opencode.json.

relPath.description: A relative path without '.' or '..' segments and without backslashes: never absolute, never the root itself, never leaving it.
